neighbours.label: a noun or ' a' expected to take a possessive: 'one of America's', 'one of Mexico's', 'increase a child's'
fire: The school is ranked as one of America's best colleges.

He owns one of Mexico's largest banks.

It is one of Canada's oldest towns.
Regular reading can raise a child's vocabulary.
Lagos is one of Africa's biggest cities.
